criteria.statement: A test shows, for every diagnostic case, arm B's evidence units equal arm A's, arm C adds only bundle rules, and arm D's units equal C's
A test shows no arm output or arm input contains any reference answer text
A test shows arm P is refused until the approved correction file exists
A test shows arms C, D, P are refused on a case outside the diagnostic manifest and diagnostic records carry `diagnostic: true`
A test asserts the diagnostic and held-out manifests are disjoint, hold ids and hashes only, and held-out runs only arm A
The manifest generator is seeded and re-running it reproduces both committed files byte-for-byte
Arm records carry an arm revision id; `apps/backend/src/prompt/`, routes and providers have no diff versus origin/main
